body:
## Fix

F1. Reject unsupported image-download CLI flags before acquisition. Previously, misspelled value options could be ignored and defaults used.
F2. Add subprocess regression proving unknown-option rejection occurs before later known-option validation; no network or asset writes.

## Validation

V1. Regression failed before fix and passed after fix.
V2. Parent reran related suite: 5 files, 29 tests passed; legacy image suite: 3 tests passed.
V3. Parent reviewed full parser, supported options, fail-fast execution, and test assertions. No blocking finding.
V4. Worker typecheck: 0 errors, 4 existing Svelte warnings. Changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff check passed.

## Limits

L1. No live downloads; full repository/browser suites not run locally. CI remains separate.
title: fix(assets): reject unknown image download options
